title: Simply Piano Practice Weekly Practice Time Trend
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=simplypiano:session practice_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(practice_minutes) as avg_duration, max(practice_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst practice time for Simply Piano practice events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture practice_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average practice time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It records whether Simply Piano practice tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
